tasks.title: Add server-side date-range validation to OvertimeReportController index() and print() (Laravel app, this repo root: G:\ipma_erp2, edit app/Http/Controllers/HumanResources/HRDept/OvertimeReportController.php ONLY). Bug: /overtimereport accepts date_start/date_end with no check that date_end is after or equal to date_start - an inverted range produces a broken/empty report table and an undefined $rows variable in the view. Fix: in the index(Request $request) method, BEFORE the `if ($request->date_start != NULL && ...)` block, add: `$request->validate(['date_start' => 'required_with:date_end,branch|date', 'date_end' => 'required_with:date_start,branch|date|after_or_equal:date_start', 'branch' => 'required_with:date_start,date_end'], ['date_end.after_or_equal' => 'The end date must be the same as or after the start date.', 'date_start.date' => 'Please select a valid start date.', 'date_end.date' => 'Please select a valid end date.']);` - this never fails on the initial GET (no fields present), but requires all three when any is submitted and rejects an inverted range with a redirect back + errors + old input (the blade already renders @error is-invalid classes). In the print(Request $request) method, add the SAME validate() call as its first statement (the print form always submits date_start/date_end/branch as hidden fields, so an inverted range must be rejected there too). Do NOT change the query logic, the middleware, or any other method. Verify: `php -l app/Http/Controllers/HumanResources/HRDept/OvertimeReportController.php` reports No syntax errors, and `php artisan tinker --execute="$r = new Illuminate\Http\Request(); $r->setMethod('POST'); $r->replace(['date_start' => '2026-08-10', 'date_end' => '2026-08-01']); try { (new App\Http\Controllers\HumanResources\HRDept\OvertimeReportController())->index($r); echo 'NO ERROR - BAD'; } catch (Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException \$e) { echo 'INVERTED REJECTED: '.\$e->validator->errors()->first('date_end'); }"` must print INVERTED REJECTED (do not let a missing session/DB block the check - if the controller constructor middleware blocks tinker, verify via a Feature test style call or `$this->validate` logic check and report what actually ran). Report the php -l result and the tinker output.

Show date-range errors in the overtime report blade + link the two date pickers in JS (Laravel app, this repo root: G:\ipma_erp2). Edit TWO files. (1) resources/views/humanresources/hrdept/overtime/overtimereport/index.blade.php: (a) after the `$currentYear`/`$lastYear` lines add `$rows = [];` so the date-column loop can never hit an undefined variable; (b) inside the form, right after the date_start input's closing tag add `@error('date_start')
{{ $message }}
@enderror` and after the date_end input's closing tag add `@error('date_end')
{{ $message }}
@enderror` (both inputs already carry the `@error('date_start') is-invalid @enderror` class - the feedback divs make the message visible). (2) resources/js/modules/overtimereport/index.js: replace the single `$('#date_start, #date_end').datetimepicker({ ...config.datetimepicker, useCurrent: true });` line with: `var $ds = $('#date_start'); var $de = $('#date_end'); $ds.datetimepicker({ ...config.datetimepicker, useCurrent: true }).on('dp.change', function () { var v = $ds.val(); if (v) { $de.data('datetimepicker').minDate(v); } else { $de.data('datetimepicker').minDate(false); } }); $de.datetimepicker({ ...config.datetimepicker, useCurrent: true }).on('dp.change', function () { var v = $de.val(); if (v) { $ds.data('datetimepicker').maxDate(v); } else { $ds.data('datetimepicker').maxDate(false); } });` - the guards are REQUIRED (an empty value passed to minDate/maxDate throws in pc-bootstrap4-datetimepicker; clearing one picker must reset the other's bound so it is not stuck). Keep the rest of the JS exactly as is. Verify: `php artisan view:cache` succeeds (blade compiles), and `npx mix` compiles cleanly (JS module picked up). Report view:cache and mix results.
